{{Quote|My grandfather used to say that superstition was the foundation of a weak mind.''"<br />"''Then we are surely doomed, for the basis of our civilization lays in the hands of high priests, shamans, and monks. Your grandfather was a wise man.|[[Thaddeus Ross]] and [[Adalric Cessius Brandl]]|<ref name="TFE">{{JournalCite|4|The Final Exit}}</ref>}}
A '''monk''' was a religious worker. The [[Qieg religion|religion]] of the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]] included monks who maintained shrines in the planet's [[Lowlands (Lan Barell)|Lowlands]].
